game.core.rules.readable.title: Saving Throws
game.core.rules.readable.summary: A saving throw responds to a threat by combining a d20 roll with the selected ability modifier and any recorded saving-throw proficiency.

blocks.heading: Resolve a save
items: Use the ability and Difficulty Class declared by the effect or ruling.
Apply the subject's recorded ability modifier and saving-throw proficiency.
Resolve advantage, disadvantage, and relevant condition effects before reporting the result.

examples.title: Condition-aware save
examples.body: A recorded condition can alter a saving throw only through its active d20-test state effect.

citations.locator: Rules Glossary > Saving Throw, PDF p. 187
